subject: Renewal: Cloud partner rebate & listing terms (AWS Marketplace)
messages:
From: Samantha Chu <samantha.chu@amazon.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-partners@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace partner renewal — updated partner fee proposal

Hi Olga,

Thanks for being an active partner on AWS Marketplace. As part of our annual program updates we
are rolling out a new fee/commission schedule for listings effective Jan 1, 2027. Attached is the
term sheet that shows the updated listing commission (moving from 6% to 8% for standard SaaS
listings) and the new co-marketing rebate tiers.

We value Redwood Inference and would like to discuss a renewal path that balances the new
structure with your growth. Preliminary options attached:
- Standard: 8% listing commission, marketing co-op eligibility at 1% revenue credit
- Growth Tier: 7% commission if annual marketplace ARR grows >= 30% year-over-year

We can also consider one-time onboarding credits and a short-term promotional rebate to help
smooth the transition. Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call next week to review?

Attachment: AWS_Partner_Renewal_Termsheet_202611.pdf (PDF / 234 KB)

Best,
Samantha Chu
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Samantha.chu@amazon.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace partner renewal — updated partner fee proposal

Team — forwarding the term sheet from AWS. Key ask: they propose standard commission up to 8%
which materially affects our unit economics on hosted API bookings.

Quick thoughts I want us to prepare before the call:
- Target outcome: keep listing commission at 6% baseline for 2027, allow staged increase tied to
  ARR growth only.
- Secondary ask: secure 2% marketing co-op (instead of their 1%), plus $75k one-time onboarding
  credit for the renewal year.
- Fallback: accept 7% commission if AWS guarantees Growth Tier metrics and commits to a 12
  month marketing fund of $50k.

Please review the attached term sheet and add specific negotiation points. Marcus — I may need
you to sign off on any concession over 50 bps. Laura/Karthik — please mark redlines and list
customer impact (pricing/ARR modeling). I put the proposed call on Samantha's calendar but we
should coordinate before we answer.

Forwarded attachment: AWS_Partner_Renewal_Termsheet_202611.pdf

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: AWS Marketplace partner renewal — updated partner fee proposal

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the term sheet and attached a short redline with comments.
High-level notes:
- Commission: An immediate bump to 8% increases gross margin impact on hosted API by ~2.6% on
  Marketplace-originated revenue — not trivial. We should resist a hard 8% floor.
- Co-op: ask for 2.0% co-op with a defined spend plan (marketing calendar + deliverables).
- Promotional support: ask for a $75k onboarding credit + 3 months of waived listing fees for any
  new product launches in 2027.
- Measurement: insist on Marketplace reporting granularity (token-level revenue attribution, per-listing
  breakdown). If reporting gap remains, we should lock in a higher rebate to compensate.

I put suggested redlines in redlined_terms_olga_v1.docx and added a short fee comparison sheet
(fee_schedule_comparison_Q4.xlsx). If AWS won't move from 8% we should push for Growth Tier
mechanics that are both reachable and auditable (e.g., ARR thresholds and monthly reporting).

Attachment: redlined_terms_olga_v1.docx (Word / 48 KB)
Attachment: fee_schedule_comparison_Q4.xlsx (Excel / 62 KB)

Laura
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: AWS Marketplace partner renewal — updated partner fee proposal

Agree with Laura's redlines. A couple tactical negotiation points and thresholds for Marcus:
- Concession thresholds: OK to accept 50 bps increase (to 6.5%) without exec approval if AWS
  commits to $50k co-op and clear measurement. Anything > 50 bps needs Marcus sign-off.
- Short-term pilot: propose a 6% listing commission for Q1–Q2 2027 with a 6-month review tied to
  Marketplace ARR growth. If growth >= 25% YoY in that window, commission steps to 6.5% and then
  to 7.0% at 12 months. This gives us runway to prove demand while limiting near-term cost.
- Marketing: push for a minimum of $50k in co-op committed to planned campaigns; insist AWS puts
  co-op in writing in the partner contract (not a hallucinated marketing promise).

I recommended a one-hour negotiation prep sync (internal) to align on walk-away numbers and who
leads each point on the call. I've added a HubSpot note with modeling and a suggested script:
https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/DF-2026-AWS-003

Karthik
Marketplace Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chu <samantha.chu@amazon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace partner renewal — updated partner fee proposal

Samantha — thanks for the term sheet and for taking time here. We reviewed the proposed changes
internally and have a recommended path for negotiation aimed at keeping the Marketplace listing
 commercially viable while recognizing AWS's updated program objectives.

Our asks:
1) Maintain a 6% baseline listing commission for Redwood for the first 6 months of 2027, with a
   pre-agreed cadence: if Marketplace ARR sourced to Redwood grows >= 25% in the first 6 months,
   commission moves to 6.5% for months 7–12; otherwise it reverts to 6% through the year.
2) Commit to $50k co-op marketing funds earmarked in writing and a $50k one-time onboarding
   credit (we proposed $75k originally; accepting $50k as compromise).
3) Provide reporting: monthly per-listing gross revenue data so we can reconcile and audit rebate
   eligibility.

If AWS is willing to accept the above, we are prepared to sign a renewal addendum and proceed
with the listing adjustments. If not, please propose the specific concessions AWS can offer in
place of the items above (e.g., higher initial credit, shorter commission ramp). We're available
for a call this Thursday 11/5 or Friday 11/6 to finalize.

Forwarded attachments: redlined_terms_olga_v1.docx; fee_schedule_comparison_Q4.xlsx

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
